descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-03 Search & Sort · S02 Hospital sort on a filtered list: room (untouched), name, status, re-filter, back to room

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U2 Hospital: sort by room, by name and by status each puts the list in the correct order. (UAT TC-03; TFA-92581 AC 4; TFA-92581 AC 5)
  • U3 Room is the primary sort: the list opens in room order, in both contexts (ticket How-it-works step 3: 'Room is the primary/default sort'). (UAT TC-03; TFA-92581 AC 4)

Test design technique: Happy path (happy-path) — Walk the normal flow exactly as the UAT / ticket words it; everything it names has to show up.

Given Four Hospital patients sharing the prefix 'E2E Sort <random>': Alpha room 12 pre-rounded, Bravo room 7 pending, Charlie room 2 post-rounded, Delta room 3 pending. The list is filtered to that prefix for the whole test

When Fill the search with the prefix and leave the sort untouched; choose name; choose status; fill the prefix again; choose name; choose room

Then Untouched sort: Charlie, Delta, Bravo, Alpha (rooms 2, 3, 7, 12). Name: Alpha, Bravo, Charlie, Delta. Status: Delta, Bravo, Alpha, Charlie, and still so after re-filtering. Then name order again, then room order again

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Playwright order assertions on the card aria-labels. The untouched-sort order is the evidence that room is the default (U3) and numeric (2 before 12). No unfiltered order is asserted, so this test says nothing about the list without a search. The expected status order is the app's STATUS_RANK, not a stated requirement (Q4). …

Where it ran: datasets (seeded data sets, list checks) on dev; test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (automated)

S02 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-03.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev, lane datasets (datasets/results.json, screenshots not attached).

Test method: PW · Playwright script — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev/datasets.
